title: Gaussian noise contraction in $L^p$
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $p$ be an extended nonnegative real number with $1\le p$. If $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ belongs to $L^p$ under the product standard Gaussian measure, then its Gaussian noise image at parameter $\rho$ has $L^p$ seminorm at most that of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is an extended nonnegative real number
$f$ belongs to $L^p$ under the product standard Gaussian measure
